title: introduce-keyproof-claims-gateway-and-audit-sparsity-controller
author: Maya Hernandez
description: Background: Customers and SRE reported noisy audit streams and ambiguous KMS routing when operator-originated requests cross region boundaries. This PR introduces a small, focused gateway that validates per-tenant residency claims (KeyProof assertions), binds them to a short-lived KMS envelope, and surfaces compact audit events. Goals: 1) Enforce an explicit per-request KeyProof claim for operator-invoked KMS operations; 2) Reduce audit volume by emitting sampled, canonicalized audit records (audit sparsity controller); 3) Provide a rollout path with opt-in config flags and a dry-run mode for policy verification. Work included: - New service: claims-gateway (Go) that validates tenant claims, checks RBAC v2 decision via PDP, and annotates KMS requests with provenance headers. - Audit sparsity controller (agent) that deduplicates repeated operator events and emits sampled canonical audit envelopes. - RBAC policy templates (OPA) and a migration helper to translate existing operator bindings into claim-aware templates. - Integration hooks in kms-proxy to accept and verify KeyProof envelopes and to secret-wrap ephemeral per-request keys. - Console telemetry additions: new dashboard panels for claim failure rates, sparsity sampling ratios, and KMS sticky routing hits. Checklist: - [x] MVP claim validator implementation - [x] OPA policies and unit tests - [x] kms-proxy integration and e2e test harness - [x] Migration tool: rbacv2-claim-adapter (dry-run compatible) - [x] Docs: internal RFC + runbook link: internal/rfc/claims-gateway.md Deployment and rollout plan: 1) Deploy claims-gateway and sparsity controller in shadow mode (dry-run) for 2 weeks in staging and a subset of prod regions. 2) Enable enforcement for dedicated capacity customers only; allow tenant opt-out for first 30 days. 3) Monitor claim-failures, KMS fallback rate, and audit volume delta. 4) After stability window, widen enforcement and enable KMS envelope wrapping by default. Migration notes: - We provide rbacv2 translation helpers that add the new attribute claim: operator:origin=service and tenancy:residency=region-*. The helper emits an RFC-friendly preview. - No direct breaking changes to the public API; operator callers without claims will be routed to compatibility fallback during rollout. Security considerations: - KeyProof envelopes are signed by operator service-mTLS and verified against operator cert pins. - The gateway enforces TTL of 5 minutes for envelopes and rejects replays. - Audit sparsity intentionally reduces noise but preserves canonical hashes for forensic reconstruction. Testing: - Unit tests for OPA policy (>=85% coverage). - Integration tests that run kms-proxy and a fake KMS to assert envelope binding and failover. - Load tests to validate that gateway adds <2ms p99 latency to operator paths under 95th percentile traffic. Related work: Linear ENG-1429; RFC at internal/rfc/claims-gateway.md; runbook at internal/runbooks/claims-gateway.md

review_conversation: Amit Singh (reviewer): Can we avoid adding a new long-lived secret? How are operator certs pinned?

Maya Hernandez (author): We do not add long-lived secrets. KeyProof envelopes are signed with existing mTLS certs and validated against the operator CA bundle stored in the truststore. Will add clarifying comments in validator.go.
Claire DuBois (reviewer): Audit sparsity makes me nervous for compliance teams. Can we provide an option to disable sparsity per-tenant?
Maya Hernandez (author): Added tenant-level toggle in values.yaml and infra docs. Default preserves full audit for customers on Compliance tier.
Jeroen van der Meij (reviewer): OPA policy looks good; request: add a small policy example for cross-region operator delegation.
Maya Hernandez (author): Added cross-region example and unit tests in operator_claims.rego (see commit b2c3d4e).
Infra (comment): Helm chart needs proper resource requests; increased small defaults to avoid OOM in staging.
QA (comment): Flaky test in claims_kms_e2e_test.go fixed by introducing backoff when fake KMS resets. CI now green.
Security (approval): Verified KeyProof envelope format and TTL enforcement; signed off for staged rollout.

release_notes: Adds a claims gateway that validates per-request KeyProof envelopes, integrates with KMS proxy for ephemeral key wrapping, and introduces an audit sparsity controller to reduce event volume. Rollout controlled by feature flags; dry-run mode available. No public API breaking changes.
